I don't have access to real-time information, including current weather conditions. I can't browse the internet or access live data.

To check today's weather, you can:
- Search "weather" on Google
- Check weather websites like weather.com or weather.gov
- Use weather apps on your phone
- Ask a voice assistant like Siri, Alexa, or Google Assistant

If you tell me your location, I could discuss typical weather patterns for that area or time of year, but I can't provide current conditions.
